verdict.rationale: The IRCC homepage links to published topics on 'Accounts (GCKey, representatives, employers and more), biometrics', so the account and identity requirements appear to be documented up front. The Start-up Visa page also states its gating prerequisite (a valid 2025 commitment certificate) before you apply. Missing for 10: the actual content of a pre-filing checklist covering account creation, credential and identity-proofing steps; evidence that these steps are stated before starting rather than discovered mid-flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
